profile.name: Kayra Uckilinc
profile.title: Full-Stack Engineer
profile.bio: Full-stack engineer. I ship products end to end: web apps in Next.js and Postgres, native Mac apps in Swift, and the odd e-ink gadget. Co-founder of keyandboard.
profile.coffee: Always open to chat about side projects and building from zero — drop me a line.

projects.name: Beluga
projects.tagline: Every project, the Claude working in each, and your friends' Claudes, Mac to Mac
projects.description: A native Mac app and terminal for running Claude across all your projects, one worktree per task. Your Claude can ask a friend's Claude to do things on their Mac, peer to peer and end-to-end encrypted, and answers come back as live charts, diagrams and task boards.
highlights: A worktree and a task board per project
Live charts and diagrams in chat

projects.name: Transkribe
projects.tagline: Private, local transcription for macOS. Every word, kept.
projects.description: Record calls, import any audio or video, or dictate into any app. Speech recognition and speaker detection run entirely on the Mac, and conversations read back like a chat with summaries, to-dos and answers on top.

projects.name: Dither
projects.tagline: Design an e-ink display in your browser and flash it over USB
projects.description: Turn a cheap e-paper panel into a calm display for your wall or desk: time, weather, meetings, trains, revenue. Design it in the browser, see a pixel-exact simulation, and flash it over USB. No server, no account.

projects.name: HeyHoney
projects.tagline: A gamified relationship companion for couples — synchronized daily rituals for iOS and Android.
projects.description: An interactive daily ritual for couples. Partners get synchronized prompts, reflect independently, then unlock each other's answers. Built native on iOS and Android with real-time sync, streaks, progress tracking, and dynamic status systems that turn emotional check-ins into a habit.

projects.name: FlyingPapers
projects.tagline: AI-native document collection for regulated workflows
projects.description: Structured document collection platform for visas, apostilles, and contracts. Clients upload and translate documents guided by AI-generated checklists. Reviewers approve via canvas-based editing tools.

projects.name: PromptArena
projects.description: Users negotiate against GPT-4, Claude, and LLaMA opponents in live sessions. A judge system scores every exchange. Built for sales teams and founders who want to sharpen their persuasion skills.

projects.name: YourLovePage
projects.tagline: Personal sharable pages for love letters and tributes
projects.description: Create a beautiful, permanent page dedicated to someone you love. Share a link — no account required to view. Built for anniversaries, birthdays, and unforgettable moments.

projects.name: Enflasyon Sepeti
projects.tagline: Crowdsourced real-time inflation tracker for Turkey
projects.description: Citizens report current prices for everyday goods. Aggregated data reveals real-world inflation trends across cities, giving people transparent, crowd-verified price intelligence.
